dandiset_id.Description: The six-digit Dandiset that was validated.

status.Description: Lifecycle status of the capsule's latest run: pending, stalled, failed, successful or unknown.

Levels.pending: A code directory exists, but the capsule has not been submitted.
Levels.stalled: A submitted marker exists, but nothing has been logged since.
Levels.failed: Logs exist without results: the run failed, or is still in progress.
Levels.successful: A derivatives directory exists: the validation completed.
Levels.unknown: Nothing that would place the capsule in the lifecycle was observed.

dandiset_version.Description: The Dandiset version that was validated (e.g. draft).

pipeline.Description: The pipeline that formed the capsule.

version.Description: The dandi-validation image's tag: its validator version code.

image_digest.Description: Digest of that dandi-validation image on GHCR.

codebase.Description: The version of dandi-validations that formed the capsule.

params.Description: Short MD5 of the parameter set file.

params_key.Description: Name of the registered parameter set.

source_digest.Description: SHA-256 over the registered assets table and dandiset.yaml.

assets.Description: Number of assets registered in the DataLad dataset that was validated.

skipped_assets.Description: Number of assets not registered (Zarr, or no SHA-256 digest yet).

created_at.Description: When the capsule's latest run was formed (UTC).

claimed_by.Description: The GitHub Actions run attempt (or host) that ran it.

run_exit_code.Description: Exit code of the run (0 for a completed validation, whatever it found).

wall_clock_seconds.Description: Wall-clock time of `datalad containers-run`, measured by duct.

peak_rss_bytes.Description: Peak resident memory of the run's process tree, measured by duct.

files_missing_content.Description: Files that could not be streamed (DANDI.FILE_CONTENT_MISSING).

files_with_issues.Description: Files with at least one CRITICAL, ERROR or WARNING result.
